alerts.title: Iran war live: Iran says US ‘not serious’ about talks; ship ablaze off Iraq
alerts.why: Ship ablaze off Iraq and stalled US-Iran talks raise Middle East supply disruption fears, lifting Brent crude.

alerts.title: As Attacks Mount, Shipping Faces an Uncomfortable Question: Are Safety Rules Fit for War?
alerts.why: Record merchant ship attacks in the Strait of Hormuz and oil washing ashore signal severe supply disruption risks in a key chokepoint.
